fields.title: INTRAMUSCULAR
fields.description: Injection delivered deeply into a large skeletal body muscle group for rapid systemic uptake.

fields.title: ORAL
fields.description: Administration through the mouth by swallowing for systematic absorption via the gastrointestinal tract.

fields.title: INTRAVENOUS
fields.description: Injection directly into a vein providing immediate delivery into the bloodstream with 100% bioavailability.

fields.title: SUBCUTANEOUS
fields.description: Injection into the fatty tissue layer situated immediately beneath the cutaneous skin layer.

fields.title: SUBLINGUAL
fields.description: Placement under the tongue to allow direct absorption through the highly vascularized mucous membranes.

fields.title: TOPICAL
fields.description: Application locally to a specific area on the surface of the body, most commonly onto skin or mucous membranes.

fields.title: INHALATION
fields.description: Administration via gas or aerosol through the respiratory tract for localized lung treatment or systemic delivery.

fields.title: RECTAL
fields.description: Administration through the rectum, useful when oral route is compromised or bypassed to avoid first-pass hepatic metabolism.

fields.title: BUCCAL
fields.description: Placement inside the mouth cheek cavity allowing absorption straight into oral mucosal blood vessels.

fields.title: TRANSDERMAL
fields.description: Delivery via a skin patch formulation for continuous, slow release into systemic circulation over extended timeframes.

fields.title: INTRADERMAL
fields.description: Injection into the dermis layer situated just below the epidermis, most commonly used for hypersensitivity skin tests.

fields.title: NASAL
fields.description: Administration into the nostrils via sprays or drops targeting local mucous layers or direct brain-barrier crossings.

fields.title: VAGINAL
fields.description: Administration into the vaginal canal for local treatment or systemic absorption.

fields.title: OPHTHALMIC
fields.description: Administration into the eye via drops or ointments for local treatment of ocular conditions.

fields.title: OTIC
fields.description: Administration into the ear canal via drops for local treatment of ear conditions.

fields.title: INTRAARTICULAR
fields.description: Injection directly into a joint space for localized treatment of joint conditions.

fields.title: INTRAPERITONEAL
fields.description: Injection into the peritoneal cavity for localized treatment or systemic absorption.

fields.title: INTRATHECAL
fields.description: Injection into the cerebrospinal fluid surrounding the spinal cord for direct central nervous system delivery.

fields.title: INTRACARDIAC
fields.description: Injection directly into the heart muscle or chambers for immediate emergency situations.
